conclusion: Expert placement is serialized with compute in these traces. The warm ordinary-staging forward spends4.813s of6.156s inside placement:3.684s of recorded H2D activity and1.129s with no recorded GPU activity. Existing pinned staging shortens recorded copy intervals but increases host-side gaps in this observed run; it does not establish an end-to-end gain.
precision_scope: The established independently qualified adapted F16 native contract; not unmodified Diffbot full-runtime equivalence.

scope.scope: Read-only diagnostic linkage of current qualified objects, passive NVTX ranges around whole grouped forward, GPU expert placement and CPU expert source acquisition. Four identical1026-token prompts,2live,1output each, two cold/warm RAM cohorts.
metrics: Union of placement/source host ranges within each forward.
H2D GPU intervals inside placement ranges; exact logical bytes must reconcile with product counters.
H2D time not overlapping any compute kernel = unhidden copy activity, not a causal latency saving.
Placement/source range time with neither kernel/copy/memset GPU activity = exposed GPU-idle loading gap.
Keep overlaps and complements disjoint; report unassigned forward work separately.
scope.acceptance: Complete independent vocabulary heads, input IDs, token/text/position prefixes. NVTX range counts and copy bytes must reconcile; preserve raw profiler output. No numerical reads in the wrappers.
scope.limitations: Profiler and wrapper overhead exclude throughput qualification. Host read/upload counters are not pure media or DMA times; GPU-idle attribution does not prove a hypothetical asynchronous speedup.

mixed_scope.scope: Unequal2050/1026-token histories,A/B/B/A,chunk2048,tails and4autoregressive decode forwards each,2live,5outputs per request. Same established numerical profile,195060MiB RAM,26008MiB GPU cache,200000MiB host cap. Additional single-forward scopes and return-status marks; production objects unchanged.

instrumentation.kind: Diagnostic-only GNU linker wrappers with NVTX ranges around expert placement, source acquisition and grouped/single forward APIs; mixed probe marks all placement return statuses.
instrumentation.observer_overhead: Not removed or estimated; all trace durations are excluded from throughput/performance acceptance.

definitions.placement: Host NVTX scope of bn_gpu_moe_trellis_acquire, including cache lookup, source and upload boundaries.
definitions.source: Nested host NVTX scope of bn_moe_host_expert_acquire_reader, including lookup/admission/reader work.
definitions.gpu_activity: Union of CUPTI kernel, memcpy and memset intervals on the single captured CUDA context; this is recorded activity, not hardware utilization.
definitions.gpu_quiet_loading_gap: Placement/source host interval minus its intersection with the recorded GPU-activity union.
definitions.unhidden_h2d: H2D activity intervals associated with placement via CUDA API correlation IDs, excluding overlap with compute-kernel intervals. Not a hypothetical latency saving.
definitions.payload_reconciliation: Whole H2D records belong to the host CUDA API inside the placement range. All payload bytes reconcile to native_batch_experts.upload_bytes.
definitions.conservation: Merge overlapping intervals, intersect scopes, and partition placement into GPU-quiet, compute-overlap and other-busy time; synthetic interval cases and exact byte/count checks pass.

ordinary_and_pinned.source_kinds: CUPTI source-kind0=Pageable for all52614 ordinary expert copies; kind1=Pinned for all52614 pinned expert copies.
ordinary_and_pinned.interpretation: The explicit pinned path is active and numerically exact. These separately instrumented runs are not a matched throughput qualification, and their cold source times differ substantially. No default policy change is supported by copy-time reduction alone.

mixed_results.source_upload_path: All26569 miss paths contain one source acquisition and three H2D records; all5199 no-upload paths contain neither, and every recorded placement returns0.
mixed_results.scope: Equivalent payload size of successful cache-hit events, not a physical bus counter or measured no-cache counterfactual.
mixed_results.interpretation: Different histories, chunk tails and decode exercise both miss and hit paths. Fully cached late calls eliminate expert transfers; calls requiring transfers still show zero copy/compute overlap. API-scope durations are diagnostic and are not cross-geometry latency comparisons.

reproduction.per_capture: Exact argv, raw profiler/product streams, source verification, SQLite export and analysis are retained in each capture directory.

limitations: Profiler/wrapper overhead and varying source-cache/physical-page conditions prevent interpreting these captures as an untraced speedup or latency regression test.
CUPTI copy intervals can include staging effects. An absence of recorded activity is conservative GPU-idle attribution, not complete hardware-counter measurement.
Zero observed copy/compute overlap does not imply all loading gaps can be hidden; dependencies, copy bandwidth, CPU bandwidth and bounded in-flight storage limit any pipeline.
Two declared prompt histories and a repeated-prefill control are not broad working-set or sustained-serving qualification.
Managed payload caps and retained idle state pass; profiler/driver/OS memory overhead and exact physical setup/device peaks remain outside this diagnostic claim.
Broader resident/offload vLLM parity, native folded/decode joint execution, modern CPU and Metal qualification remain open.
next_action: Implement and independently qualify bounded lookahead expert loading while current-wave consumers compute. Preserve original split-K/tile arithmetic, leases until every consumer drains, fixed cache/staging quotas, public BUSY/failure semantics and explicit fallbacks; require untraced paired benefit.
